t_w_pct_diff_vrhs_vlhs.description: The difference between a team's winning percentage in games where the opposing starting pitcher was right-handed vs. left-handed, negative indicates better vs. left-handers

t_w_pct_post_asb.description: Winning percent after the All-Star break. (NOTE: first All-Star game was in 1933)

t_w_pct_pre_asb.description: Winning percent before the All-Star break. (NOTE: first All-Star game was in 1933)

t_w_pct_vlhs.description: Winning percent in games where the opposing starting pitcher was left-handed

t_w_pct_vrhs.description: Winning percent in games where the opposing starting pitcher was right-handed

t_w_post_asb.description: Wins after the All-Star break. (NOTE: first All-Star game was in 1933)

t_w_pre_asb.description: Wins before the All-Star break. (NOTE: first All-Star game was in 1933)

t_w_vlhs.description: Wins in games where the opposing starting pitcher was left-handed

t_w_vrhs.description: Wins in games where the opposing starting pitcher was right-handed

team_Blown_Lead_Losses.description: Losses after leading at any point in game

team_Comeback_Wins.description: Wins after trailing at any point in game

team_Holds.description: Team total for holds by relief pitchers

team_Runs_Allowed_For_hr_pct.description: Teams, percentage of runs allowed to opponents which came via RBI from allowing a home run.

team_Runs_Allowed_From_hr.description: Teams, total number of runs allowed to opponents which came via RBI from allowing a home run.

team_Runs_From_Hr_pct.description: Teams, percentage of runs scored which came via RBI from hitting a home run.

team_Runs_From_hr.description: Teams, total number of runs scored which came via RBI from hitting a home run.

team_Shutouts.description: Teams, number of games allowing zero runs to opponent

team_Walkoff_Losses.description: Number of games where the team lost via walkoff (opponent team won by walkoff)

team_Walkoff_Wins.description: Number of games where the team won via walkoff

walkoff_Hits.description: Batters, walkoff hits (single, double, triple, or home run)

walkoff_Rbis.description: Batters, walkoff RBI (any walkoff result in which the run that won the game was an RBI for the batter)

war.description: Season-level statistic measuring a players wins above replacement as a player (hitting+pitching)

war_Baserunning.description: Season-level statistic measuring a players wins above replacement as a baserunner.

war_Batting.description: Season-level statistic measuring a players wins above replacement as an offensive player.

war_Batting_Per_Full_Season.description: A batter's WAR in a given season projected over 162 games. ONLY INCLUDES BATTING WAR - DOES NOT INCLUDE PITCHING WAR

war_Batting_Specific.description: Season-level statistic measuring a players wins above replacement as a batter (hitting only)

war_Fielding.description: Season-level statistic measuring a players wins above replacement as a fielder.

war_Pitching.description: Season-level statistic measuring a players wins above replacement as a pitcher.

whip_Three_Decimals.description: Pitchers, Walks + Hits allowed per Inning Pitched (formatted to include the thousandth place)
